data.name: Bartley
data.long_meaning: The name Bartley is derived from the Old English words 'beorht' meaning bright or glorious, and 'leah' meaning a clearing in a forest or a farm. This name was traditionally given to boys born on farms or in rural areas, as a reflection of their strong and hardworking nature.
